schedule.unit: relative business weeks from confirmed kickoff
schedule.staffing: Three engineers across core/database, integrations and reporting/frontend; one QA engineer; part-time controller/domain reviewers and SRE. Roles are proposed, not assigned people.
exclusions: Full multi-currency functionality beyond the selected supported scope
External statutory approval or provider certification lead times

phases.name: Establish the execution baseline
phases.outcome: Current findings reproduced or explicitly superseded; supported policy, owners, isolated environment and exposure scan agreed.

phases.name: Contain the demonstrated risks
phases.outcome: Currency, locked settings, source reversal and finance-label protections verified through direct service/action paths.

phases.name: Protect ledger history and period boundaries
phases.outcome: Tenant references, posted immutability, concurrent lifecycle and fiscal calendars validated on PostgreSQL.

phases.name: Reconcile every material producer and close
phases.outcome: POS, AP, inventory, payroll, payments and event recovery satisfy the shared source/ledger/close contracts.

phases.name: Correct reporting and finance totals
phases.outcome: Reports have correct currency, opening/closing, full populations and consistent bounded reads.

phases.name: Finish accountant workflows and cache controls
phases.outcome: Amounts, scope, stale states, pagination, sensitive-action review and access changes are reliable in both locales.

phases.name: Rehearse data correction and prove the release
phases.outcome: Repair evidence or verified no-repair disposition, green candidate tests, deployment rehearsal and release packet.

phases.name: Pilot, observe and close the findings
phases.outcome: A bounded pilot completes observed operations and a close cycle; all released-scope findings have accepted evidence.

tasks.title: Rebaseline the audit on a stable candidate
tasks.deliverable: Candidate commit/source hashes; refreshed finding register; actual owners and PR boundaries.
acceptance: Reproduce or supersede each ACC finding against the chosen working revision; retain the old evidence.
Identify concurrent AP changes and distinguish existing fixes from remaining work.
Record named owners and exact test commands; do not copy audit defects blindly into implementation.

tasks.title: Freeze accounting and workflow contracts
tasks.deliverable: Versioned money, calendar, policy-change, source-ownership and close-state contracts.
acceptance: Declare supported base currencies, precision, rounding stage, business dates/timezone and fiscal boundaries.
Specify posting lock versus reviewed close versus certified export; classify allowed manual adjustments.
Define shared report/cache DTOs early enough to remove circular implementation dependencies.

tasks.title: Provision isolated verification and fixtures
tasks.deliverable: Disposable PostgreSQL database, real application role, two tenants, actor roles and reproducible financial fixtures.
acceptance: No production writes or seeded customer records.
Fixtures include cash/credit sales, AP, inventory, payroll, suspense, reversal, closed period and mixed-currency rejection.
Authenticated browser roles and concurrency barriers work; environment scripts are reviewed before execution.

tasks.title: Measure existing data exposure
tasks.deliverable: Read-only exposure report grouped by tenant, source, period and currency, with a repair classification.
acceptance: Scan currency/base inconsistencies, historical settings, generic source reversals, orphan/foreign references and overlapping periods.
Compare closed periods with source failures and assurance blockers.
Classify none found, confirmed affected, or access unavailable; unavailable is never treated as clean.

tasks.title: Enforce the supported currency scope
tasks.deliverable: Server-enforced currency admission and explicit unsupported/mixed-data report states.
acceptance: Every producer derives the correct supported organization/source currency instead of falling back silently to XAF.
Unsupported conversion fails explicitly; contaminated historical aggregates cannot appear trustworthy.
Existing settlement/correction obligations receive an explicit supported recovery path rather than a blanket dead end.

tasks.title: Protect material accounting settings
tasks.deliverable: Validated policy enums and a used/locked-setting mutation boundary.
acceptance: Direct actions and service calls reject prohibited base-currency, valuation and calendar mutations.
Before/after policy evidence is retained for permitted changes.
Any future effective-dated transition is separate from an unrestricted generic update.

tasks.title: Restrict generic reversal to valid sources
tasks.deliverable: Source-to-correction routing and guarded generic reversal.
acceptance: POS/AP/inventory/payroll/payment source types cannot bypass their owning correction command.
Legitimate manual adjustment and reversal semantics remain supported and traceable.
Current authorization, reason/date and source identity are validated; a UI-only restriction does not pass.

tasks.title: Correct misleading finance proof labels
tasks.deliverable: Truthful operational-versus-ledger labels and partial-source disclosure.
acceptance: Operational sales orders never receive a posted-ledger badge by assumption.
Heuristic confidence cannot produce certification.
Existing capped metrics are visibly partial until full-population aggregation is delivered in ACR-21.

tasks.title: Enforce tenant-safe ledger relationships and dimensions
tasks.deliverable: Constraint design, scoped dimension validation, migration preflight and invalid-reference report.
acceptance: Foreign or missing account/parent/customer/supplier/item/location references fail at the appropriate boundary.
Existing invalid references are investigated before constraints are validated.
Retention, cascade behavior and permitted historical dimension changes are documented.

tasks.title: Make posted financial content immutable
tasks.deliverable: Migration and privilege boundary for posted monetary content, with safe allowed transitions.
acceptance: Application-role SQL cannot mutate/delete protected posted financial content.
Valid multi-line posting and controlled reversal/status changes remain possible within one transaction.
Migration rehearsals include existing data, backup/restore, validation failure and rollback behavior.

tasks.title: Serialize posting, reversal and closing
tasks.deliverable: Shared period-lock order, atomic lifecycle claims, stable command identity and bounded retries.
acceptance: Real PostgreSQL tests cover post-versus-close, simultaneous reversal and ambiguous-commit retry.
Close acquires its boundary before preflight; writers use the compatible protocol.
Retries neither create an extra effect nor leave the caller with an unexplained result; deadlocks terminate predictably.

tasks.title: Correct fiscal boundaries and overlapping periods
tasks.deliverable: Calendar boundary fix and concurrent overlap protection.
acceptance: Short years, mid-month starts, leap dates and timezone cutoffs resolve correctly.
Each allowed date has the intended unambiguous period.
Existing posted calendar exceptions follow reviewed correction rather than silent reassignment.

tasks.title: Verify POS, refunds and offline replay against the kernel
tasks.deliverable: POS source-to-stock/tender/ledger reconciliation suite and owned recovery contract.
acceptance: Cash, credit, split tender, discounts/tax, refund/void and source cost effects reconcile.
Duplicate/offline replay and lost responses create one intended effect; changed payloads fail.
Shift-close evidence assertions match the intended event audit contract.

tasks.title: Verify purchasing/AP recognition and correction
tasks.deliverable: PO/receipt/invoice/payment/credit reconciliation matrix and validated posting recovery.
acceptance: Partial receipts and receipt/invoice timing differences have explicit clearing/exception ownership.
Posting replay verifies source hashes and existing effects; preparation correction cannot alter posted obligations.
Supplier payment, return and credit corrections reconcile to source, subledger and GL.

tasks.title: Verify inventory valuation and corrections
tasks.deliverable: Valuation/COGS/source-movement reconciliation with adjustment and reversal proof.
acceptance: Receipt/issue/transfer/reservation semantics preserve owned-stock meaning.
Backdating and negative-stock behavior are either policy-valid and tested or explicitly blocked.
Write-off/adjustment/reversal and source currency reconcile to class-3 accounts and close evidence.

tasks.title: Verify payroll, settlement and suspense integrations
tasks.deliverable: Payroll/AR/payment/suspense reconciliation cases and current evidence boundaries.
acceptance: Approved payroll liabilities and later payments/corrections reconcile without exposing person-level data to unauthorized readers.
Customer allocation, provider evidence, fees/suspense and partial matching cannot double-consume a source amount.
Country/provider applicability is explicit; unavailable external evidence blocks only the capability that depends on it.

tasks.title: Unify close blockers and evidence freshness
tasks.deliverable: Shared close readiness contract including unassigned failures and applicable module evidence.
acceptance: Inventory/payroll/AP/payment blockers govern the policy-defined reviewed-close transition.
Late source changes invalidate affected evidence and exports; current evidence is rechecked at action time.
Locked, closed, reviewed and certified states remain distinct and existing stronger pack controls are preserved.

tasks.title: Harden event conflict recovery and operational ownership
tasks.deliverable: Resolved event-test contract drift, replay runbook and failure/age signals.
acceptance: Inventory conflict testing proves durable conflict evidence and no stock mutation, including evidence-write failure.
Outbox duplicate, stale lease, retry exhaustion and changed-payload cases retain a recoverable state.
Each pending/failed source has an owner and a documented recovery action.

tasks.title: Define one financial report and cache contract
tasks.deliverable: DTO contract for currency, scope, opening/activity/closing, as-of version, completeness and access identity.
acceptance: P&L activity and cumulative balance sheet use explicit different windows.
Paging, aggregate totals, stable ordering and source proof meanings are defined before implementation.
Cache identity includes every result-changing filter and access scope; no dependency on finished UI is required.

tasks.title: Correct report monetary and balance semantics
tasks.deliverable: Correct GL opening/activity/closing, currency aggregation and exact decimal serialization.
acceptance: Opening plus activity equals closing for debit/credit accounts, including cross-period reversal.
Mixed unsupported currency is rejected or safely partitioned under the approved policy.
TB, GL, statements and exact exports agree; archived posted accounts and contra-account signs remain correct.

tasks.title: Bound reporting work and preserve snapshot consistency
tasks.deliverable: SQL totals, cursor details, consistent report version and benchmark evidence.
acceptance: 100k-line fixtures and the measured pilot tenant envelope meet agreed latency/payload budgets.
Concurrent posting cannot produce an internally inconsistent report snapshot.
Pagination/streaming maintains ordering and totals; any summary rebuild reconciles to the ledger.

tasks.title: Correct full-population finance metrics
tasks.deliverable: Ledger/operational metric separation, uncapped totals and source-backed labels.
acceptance: More than 250 source rows produce complete totals or an explicit unavailable/partial state.
Recognized revenue, COGS, expenses and cash movements retain distinct definitions.
Proof labels derive from evidence state, not a heuristic score or the absence of an overdue item.

tasks.title: Implement scoped cache and mutation invalidation
tasks.deliverable: Scoped key factories, cache eviction and a cross-module invalidation matrix.
acceptance: Two tenants, different limits and changed permission/consent versions never reuse protected results.
Logout without reload, revocation and session changes remove stale protected cache.
Posting, reversal, payment, reconciliation and close refresh all affected mounted views.

tasks.title: Complete safe accountant UI and localized formatting
tasks.deliverable: Correct currency/decimal display, server totals/paging, visible stale/error states and reviewed financial actions.
acceptance: More than 100 journals remain discoverable; count scope is accurate.
Invalid/missing/stale values cannot look like current certified zeroes.
English/French desktop/mobile and keyboard/screen-reader flows show source, date, amount and action consequences.

tasks.title: Rehearse and reconcile any required data repair
tasks.deliverable: Tenant-scoped repair packet or verified no-repair disposition; rehearsal reconciliation and rollback proof.
acceptance: Every affected record has source evidence, proposed correction, reviewer and before/after reconciliation.
Preserve original posted history; use owned corrections/adjustments or a reviewed migration design.
Estimate is for packet/rehearsal only; unknown-volume live repair is separately estimated and blocks affected tenants from pilot.

tasks.title: Prove the release candidate end to end
tasks.deliverable: Candidate-specific verification packet and a deployment/rollback rehearsal.
acceptance: Affected regression suites are green; direct endpoint, real DB concurrency and authenticated UI tests cover the repaired findings.
Installed constraints/privileges match the candidate; backup/restore and deploy failure are rehearsed.
No unresolved high-risk finding remains in the proposed release scope; unsupported statutory/provider/FX capabilities stay explicitly gated.

tasks.title: Pilot the correction set with close observation
tasks.deliverable: Bounded tenant pilot, daily reconciliation dashboard and observed close cycle.
acceptance: Start with one eligible tenant/scope, then expand to 3–5 only after the first gate remains clean.
Observe at least ten business days and one complete close/reconciliation cycle; use a longer window if the real close calendar requires it.
Unexplained mismatch, duplicate effect, closed-period write or tenant leak stops expansion and invokes the incident plan.

tasks.title: Close findings and expand within proven scope
tasks.deliverable: Accepted finding evidence, residual-scope register, release decision and support handover.
acceptance: Each ACC finding is verified fixed, no longer reproducible with proof, or outside the explicitly restricted release scope.
Data repair, runbooks, owners and pilot results are attached to the exact released revision.
Completion is evidence-based; neither code merged nor a percentage-complete dashboard alone closes a financial control.

coverage.title: Currency conversion and reporting do not preserve base-currency meaning
Generic journal reversal bypasses source-owned correction workflows
Posting, reversal and period close lack a uniform concurrency protocol
Period closure and close-assurance readiness use different blockers
Manual journal dimensions are not validated against tenant ownership
Ledger immutability and tenant consistency depend primarily on application paths
Fiscal period creation can extend before the requested fiscal year and allows overlap
Date-filtered general ledger omits the opening balance
Accountant portal cache identity and refresh coverage are incomplete
Shared accounting display can mislabel currency, round away precision and turn invalid values into zero
Journal and portal screens overstate completeness or freshness in edge states
Large ledger reads are unbounded and statements lack a shared read snapshot
Finance operational metrics are presented with accounting proof labels
Integration verification is not green and production assurance evidence remains incomplete

gates.criteria: Current candidate and finding dispositions recorded; owners, supported policy and test fixtures defined. Exposure access gaps have owners and block affected production/pilot claims, not independent implementation.

All four containment changes pass direct service/action tests. Reporting clearly identifies unsupported or contaminated populations. Existing financial obligations retain a controlled resolution path.
Real application-role SQL and PostgreSQL concurrency tests prove tenant references, posted immutability, period finality and allowed correction semantics. Constraint rollout has a tested preflight.

POS, AP, inventory, payroll and settlement/suspense each reconcile source, subledger, GL and close evidence. Durable failures are visible, owned and recoverable. The two audit integration failures are resolved without weakening controls.

Report currency, opening/activity/closing, full-population totals and a common as-of contract pass independent expected-value fixtures. Agreed resource budgets are met without sacrificing consistency.

Authenticated English/French workflows show correct amounts and states; large histories remain discoverable; consent/session changes evict protected cache; keyboard and assistive-technology review is complete.

Exact release candidate has green affected suites, database/access/UI evidence and a rehearsed deploy/rollback. Affected historical data has been corrected and reconciled before admission to the pilot, or the tenant remains excluded.
Pilot observation and a complete close cycle meet the acceptance criteria. Every released-scope finding has accepted evidence, support ownership and a controlled expansion decision.
